repriced.note: Harbor's recorded cost ($4.48) priced prompt-cache writes as plain input. Repriced from each trial's token usage (card-packs catalog 2026-10-10.3) with writes at 125% of the input rate, OpenAI's cache-write price for GPT-5.6 and later: $4.61 (+2.9%) over the same 446 trials.

tokens.basis: Harbor per-trial input_tokens (includes cached), cache_tokens, output_tokens

notes: Six-hour agent timeout (override_timeout_sec=21600) on the fixed-QEMU TB2.1 snapshot; a modified evaluation, not a leaderboard-eligible configuration.

bench-run cohort on HF Jobs (Harbor b20373d6) with the published fast-agent-mcp 0.10.42 wheel; GPT-6 Luna (high reasoning) through the OpenAI Responses API with an API key, flex service tier. Zero whole-trial retries; fast-agent's own provider retries apply. One infrastructure failure (a read timeout) was rerun as a replacement; the original is kept as evidence.

Ran 1–3 October, after the flex serving anomaly bench-run recorded on 30 September–1 October (a faster serving path with lower task success, which wrote off three TB4 cohorts); no trial of this run falls in that window.

Harbor's recorded cost uses the cohort's configured OpenAI flex rates (card-packs pricing catalog 2026-09-29.1, rules gpt-6-luna-flex-short / -long: $0.05 / $0.005 / $0.25 per million input / cached / output tokens; $0.10 / $0.01 / $0.375 above 272k context). Some trials have model calls that reported no usage, so the total is a lower bound. Harbor recorded prompt-cache writes at the input rate; the cost shown is repriced with writes at 125% of the input rate, OpenAI's cache-write price for GPT-5.6 and later.
